page.overview:
Who is Kazabune?

Kazabune has short brown hair and a small brown goatee. He also has dark-coloured eyes. He wears a light green-coloured tank top shirt.

Jiraiya accidentally destroys his cart while demonstrating the Rasengan, so he pays for the damage with money taken from Gantetsu. He also buys Kazabune's entire inventory of balloons to teach Naruto the Rasengan.
